criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only random_source=None to wait_random, wait_random_exponential and wait_exponential_jitter. None retains the existing random module and mockability; an explicit source supplies random() or uniform() as required. Validate the needed method, preserve bounds, exponential overflow handling, existing positional parameters and every old wait result formula. Independent random.Random sources must be reproducible without reseeding or consuming global random state. Composition must still work; do not add dependencies.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
